items.title: Art Farmer — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Yeah, Donald is my man. Donald is so funny. Donald is still Donald.

ctx.x: Looking at what’s going on with jazz today, you have the path being blazed by Wynton, you have Donald Byrd doing his hip-hop…
Yeah, Donald is my man. Donald is so funny. Donald is still Donald. He can play if he wants to. With all this funny stuff he gets into [laughs].
I take it that’s not something you listen to [laughs].
